name: Andrew designs
author: Andrew Tang
description: Andrew Tang is a product designer at the intersection of design and data, building data tools and human-in-the-loop AI workflows as working software.
intro: Hi, I’m Andrew and I work at the **intersection of design + data**, designing user-centered tools for exploring data to discover insights, uncover trends, and enable data-driven decisions. I use AI to ship them as working software, and I’m currently designing human-in-the-loop agentic workflows.
